description: KOL convergence signals (v1.2) — tokens being accumulated by multiple KOLs. Response includes peak_kols/peak_buys (busiest window slice), exited_count (net-flow-negative wallets), 0-100 coordination_score, and (v1.2 / 2026-05-06) market_cap_usd_at_first_buy + market_cap_usd + last_price_usd so you can see whether the cluster formed at micro-cap or after the chart was already running. Blacklist filters WIF/BONK/stables by default.

include_majors.description: v1.1: include major memecoins (WIF/BONK/POPCAT). Default false.

limit.description: Number of coordination signals to return

min_avg_winrate.description: PRO+: require cluster avg winrate_7d >= N (0-100)

min_kols.description: Minimum number of KOLs converging on the same token

unique_strategies.description: PRO+: require >= N distinct strategies in cluster

name: madeonsol_kol_coordination
